title: Telegram revenue jumps to $870M in H1 2025; $2B full-year target: FT
summary: Telegram’s H1 2025 revenue climbed 65% to $870 million, while Toncoin write-downs and $500 million in frozen bonds have added pressure.

title: Morgan Stanley files S-1s for Bitcoin and Solana ETFs in latest crypto push
summary: The investment banking giant’s filings for Bitcoin and Solana ETFs follow an uptick in investor demand for regulated crypto investment vehicles, driven by the new year’s “clean-slate” effect.

title: Polymarket quietly introduces taker fees on 15-minute crypto markets
summary: Polymarket updated its documentation to show taker-only fees on short-term crypto markets, with proceeds redistributed to market makers as liquidity rebates.

title: BitMEX pushes into 24/7 stock perps as tokenized equities heat up
summary: BitMEX is rolling out 24/7 Equity Perps that use crypto as collateral for exposure to major US stocks and indexes, as exchanges from Bitget to Kraken race to bring equities onchain.

title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $697M in second trading day of 2026
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have hauled in $1.1 billion in the first two trading days of 2026, with analysts pointing to a new year “clean-slate effect” driving digital asset demand.

title: Is Venezuela hiding a 600K Bitcoin reserve? Analysts remain unsure
summary: Venezuela’s early crypto adoption and gold-to-Bitcoin conversion speculation raise questions about a $60 billion reserve, though analysts have found no proof.

title: Bitcoin Core v30 bug risks fund loss during legacy wallet upgrades
summary: A migration flaw affecting older wallet setups can wipe local wallet files under specific conditions, prompting developers to pull recent releases.

title: South Korea considers pre-emptive crypto account freezes, report says
summary: The proposal highlights South Korea’s push to align crypto oversight with securities markets, raising stakes for exchanges and traders alike.

title: Bitcoin buying metric with average 109% gains flips positive at $88K
summary: Institutional Bitcoin purchases exceeded newly mined supply for eight consecutive days, a signal that has historically preceded major BTC price upside.

title: ‘Mixed year for IPOs’ as crypto pulls down US IPO performance
summary: Investors would have been better off investing in the S&P500 than betting on US initial public offerings in 2025, with crypto and AI public debuts partly to blame.
